adaptation_notes: Trending format (#10 Problem macro): 2 brands. Both references rely on an extreme skin-problem close-up; that is fear framing the brand avoids and would need real photos, so the macro is dropped and the structure kept as calm callouts with the pack. No acne wording (CLM-02). Round 3 (user review 2026-10-04): rebuilt as a lifestyle shot (reused AI image of an Indian man back from a run, from run 2026-10-03-people) with the brand taglines: a black Skin Science tag and the Hide Nothing. sign-off. Headline: Solution became Meet and the 2% is named (judge advisory). A model is used, so Severe (user rule). Round 4 (judge block): 2% BHA + LHA read as 2% salicylic acid alone; the 2% is BHA + LHA combined, so the headline drops the figure and the product name line beneath (Salicylic Acid + LHA 2% Cleanser) carries it. Re-checked by the rules and the round-3 judge findings (span-checked), not a fresh judge pass. The judge also noted, as a lesser point, that Hide Nothing. near a skin-concern headline could read as a promise; it stays as the brand sign-off under the logo.
